explicit_scope.instruction: sl st in next 2 dc and into the next corner ch-2 space; ch 3 (counts as first dc), 2 dc, ch 2, 3 dc in that same corner. Work 3 dc in every GAP between adjacent 3-dc groups along each side (these are not chain spaces), and (3 dc, ch 2, 3 dc) in each remaining corner; sl st to top of ch-3. Each round adds one 3-dc group to every side (+12 dc per round)
explicit_scope.scope: R3–R20: four corners produce24 dc plus 4*(N-2) side gaps each producing3; exact formula checked for every round

explicit_scope.instruction: [ch 5, skip next st, sl st in next st] x 6
explicit_scope.scope: Six chain spaces, final repeat lands on initial anchor; no duplicate joining slip stitch

explicit_scope.instruction: (sl st, ch 3, 3 tr, ch 3, sl st) in each of the 6 ch-5 spaces, sl st to first sl st, FO
explicit_scope.scope: Six arms, each three tall stitches and two slip stitches; 36 side-chain links are additional

explicit_scope.instruction: Ch 20, check the relaxed ring against the stand, then sl st to first ch without twisting
explicit_scope.scope: 20-chain foundation ring, or explicitly allowed 24-chain alternative; R1 is into ring not chains

explicit_scope.instruction: Join CC through the fabric immediately outside the centre ring; work relaxed surface sl sts outward along one pinned guide to its marked increase column; FO at the outer edge
explicit_scope.scope: Variable number of surface slip stitches; no growth stitches added

explicit_scope.instruction: Repeat the complete join-to-FO spoke route separately at each remaining marked column
Join CC in any st; ch 1, sc in SAME st, skip 2 sts, 5 dc in next st, skip 2 sts; repeat [sc in next st, skip 2 sts, 5 dc in next st, skip 2 sts] to end, sl st to first sc, FO
explicit_scope.scope: Starting sc in same joining anchor. Border checked at all three stop sizes

explicit_scope.instruction: Ch 12, sl st to first ch to form a ring; place marker
explicit_scope.scope: 12-chain closed foundation, no turning chain counted

explicit_scope.instruction: FO with a 40 cm tail; keep openings round, align the 12 final-round sts with the 12 foundation ch, and whip-stitch 12 pairs around
explicit_scope.scope: 12 matched seam pairs; final 3 pairs closed after stuffing

explicit_scope.instruction: For the standard/large version, lay the joined loop on a fully supporting display surface; no unsupported vertical hanger is specified
explicit_scope.scope: Supported flat display only; no crochet count or load certification

explicit_scope.instruction: Join red with a sl st in any centre sc; (ch 4, 3 tr, ch 4, sl st) in that same centre stitch; [sl st in next centre sc, (ch 4, 3 tr, ch 4, sl st) in that same stitch] x 5; FO
explicit_scope.scope: Six separately anchored petals; tall stitches and chains checked; positioning and end sl sts are not new centre anchors

explicit_scope.instruction: Attach one folded 55 cm green tie under at least 2 sturdy back sts as in technique 4
explicit_scope.scope: Removable folded tie, anchored under at least two back stitches; no round count

explicit_scope.instruction: [Ch 5, skip next dc, sl st in next dc] x 6
explicit_scope.scope: Six chain spaces, final repeat lands on initial anchor; no duplicate joining slip stitch

explicit_scope.instruction: In each ch-5 space work (sl st, ch 3, 3 tr, ch 3, sl st); sl st to the first sl st, FO
explicit_scope.scope: Six arms, each three tall stitches and two slip stitches; 36 side-chain links are additional

explicit_scope.instruction: Attach one folded 55 cm white/silver tie under at least 2 sturdy back sts as in technique 4
explicit_scope.scope: Removable folded tie, anchored under at least two back stitches; no round count
